definitions.explanation: Trying extremely hard with full effort, often in a dire situation.
A situation where death is unavoidable (literary/classical usage).

examples.japanese: {必死|ひっし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{必死|ひっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形相|ぎょうそう}→形相：16174_gyousou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He was running with a desperate look on his face.

examples.japanese: {必死|ひっし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{説得|せっとく}した→説得：14219_settoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I tried desperately to persuade them, but it was useless.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{必死|ひっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I put the opponent in an inescapable position in shogi.
examples.notes: In shogi, {必死|ひっし} refers to a position where checkmate cannot be avoided

examples.japanese: ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{必死|ひっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{覚悟|かくご}→覚悟：02551_kakugo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戦|たたか}った→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。
examples.english: The soldiers fought with a do-or-die resolve.
examples.notes: {必死|ひっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{覚悟|かくご}→覚悟：02551_kakugo⟧ = desperate resolve, prepare for the worst

examples.japanese: {必死|ひっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{奇跡的|きせきてき}→奇跡的：28181_kisekiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生還|せいかん}した→生還：13566_seikan⟧。
examples.english: He miraculously survived from a life-or-death situation.

notes:
Often used adverbially with に to mean "desperately" or "frantically."

FORMS:
- {必死|ひっし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do something desperately)
- {必死|ひっし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧ (becoming desperate)
- {必死|ひっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun ({必死|ひっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧ = desperate effort)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {必死|ひっし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work frantically)
- {必死|ひっし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ (to flee desperately)
- {必死|ひっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{覚悟|かくご}→覚悟：02551_kakugo⟧ (desperate resolve)
- {必死|ひっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧ (desperate resistance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}→一生懸命：01280_isshoukenmei⟧ - with all one's might (more positive)
- {必死|ひっし} - desperate, frantic (implies urgency/danger)
